text: The GCF-UNDP Nepal GLOF Risk Project aims to protect lives and livelihoods from the risks posed by Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) and climate change-induced flooding in Nepal's glacial river basins. The project involves physical interventions to lower water levels in high-risk glacial lakes, expand hazard monitoring and early warning systems, implement ecosystem-based and eco-engineering measures, and build institutional capacity for climate risk integration and preparedness.
